Udacity Data Analyst exploration and explanatory presentation using 2019 Bay Wheels/Ford GoBike trips.

The rhythm of a bike-sharing city

Explore when people ride, how long they ride and how subscriber behavior differs from casual use.

Python · pandas · Matplotlib · Seaborn

The question

A trip table becomes useful when time and rider segments reveal practical patterns.

The work

  • Derive hour, weekday, month, quarter and weekend features.
  • Use log-scaled duration plots to manage a skewed distribution.
  • Compare trip volume and duration across time and rider groups.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Source analysis covers about 2.4 million trip records and shows morning/evening weekday peaks.
  • Saved charts show hourly patterns, weekday/weekend mix and monthly variation.

What I learned

  • Use exploratory detail to build a compact explanatory story.

Project context

  • Historical observational study; the plots do not prove why people chose to ride.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
